LanguageData.BGH_AvoidFriendlyFire_Tip: Avoid launching explosives if there is at least 1 ally in blast radius
LanguageData.BGH_MinFlammabilityToIgnore_Tip: Ignore allies in the blast area if their flammability is below the threshold.\n\nFlammability - how likely you are to catch on fire
LanguageData.BGH_MinHeatArmorToIgnore: Incendiary - Minimum overall heat armor to ignore
LanguageData.BGH_MinHeatArmorToIgnore_Tip: Ignore allies in the blast area if their overall heat armor is above the threshold.\n\nHeat armor - how resistant you are to burn when you catch on fire
LanguageData.BGH_MinToxicResistanceToIgnore: Toxic - Minimum toxic environment resistance to ignore
LanguageData.BGH_MinToxicResistanceToIgnore_Tip: Ignore allies in the blast area if their resistance is above the threshold
LanguageData.BGH_AvoidExplosives_Tip: Avoid traversing over explosives launched by friendlies
LanguageData.BGH_FleeExplosives_Tip: Flee from explosives when launched at you by friendlies
LanguageData.BGH_AvoidShells_Tip: Avoid crossing areas where friendly shells are about to land or already present
LanguageData.BGH_FleeShells_Tip: Flee from shells when launched at you by friendlies
